purpose: A compact maturity contract for instruments that have become important enough to survive beyond one experiment.

maturity_gate.required_when: STABLE, or an EXPERIMENT has a retained unique mechanism/public route and is being used as a donor for other work.
maturity_gate.not_required_for: one-off sketches, raw recovery copies, quarantined generic descendants, or fixtures whose only job is falsification.
maturity_gate.rule: The charter explains why an instrument deserves continued complexity; it is not marketing copy.

charter_fields.PASSION: The human tension, delight, care, or curiosity that makes this worth carrying.
charter_fields.PURPOSE: The bounded transformation/job the instrument exists to perform.
charter_fields.POWER: The unique capability it adds beyond plain text/list/manual handling.
charter_fields.PROOF: What falsifiable evidence shows the power is real rather than aesthetic.
charter_fields.PROMISE: The invariant or refusal the instrument must preserve.
charter_fields.PRICE: The cognitive, technical, physical, or maintenance cost that must keep paying rent.
charter_fields.RETURN: The durable thing that leaves the instrument and permits continuation.

documentation_law: PASSION may be poetic; PURPOSE and PROOF may not be vague.
seal_projection: A seal/glyph may later compress a stable charter, but the mark must remain traceable back to this machine-readable contract rather than becoming decoration.

shared_motifs.invariant: One thing may have many unequal views without silently changing identity.
A path is an ordered program whose transitions must say BY what relation they are legal.
A consequential cycle ends with evidence, residue, and a re-entry path rather than indefinite elaboration.
Meaningful state can live in the relation/delta between two positions rather than inside either endpoint alone.
Drafting, simulation, or recommendation remains distinct from permission to execute/send/act.

instruments.PASSION: Preserve contact, character, wit, care, and work cadence when language must become small.
instruments.PURPOSE: Turn an observed exchange into a bounded response move or trajectory, and project a small subset of LINE objects into a self-directed work cadence, while keeping provenance and human agency explicit.
instruments.POWER: Treat LINE, SCENE, CARE, PLAY, CELEBRATE, REPAIR, FRAGMENT, and WORK as unequal projections/paths rather than one flattened response bank; WORK reuses LINE objects and adds no fifth content class.
PROOF: exact recovered scenes remain distinguishable from new work
branch integrity holds
real-use receipts show a chosen path helped more than unconstrained drafting or did not
WORK cycles the same LINE ids through HEAT → FORM → COOL → POLISH → REPEAT; transient auto cadence cannot mutate canon
instruments.PROMISE: No hidden diagnosis, no sentiment-as-truth, no automatic sending, no recovered/new provenance collapse.
instruments.PRICE: More structure than ordinary drafting or a plain mantra list; only recurring/consequential exchanges or work cadence should pay for it.
instruments.RETURN: chosen draft or trajectory, or transient work set + provenance + branch/phase state + unresolved next move

instruments.PASSION: See the same thing at radically different scales without losing where it came from.
instruments.PURPOSE: Project an addressed object across domain, scope, range, and spatial views while retaining canonical identity and upstream return.
instruments.POWER: Separates canonical identity from local/projection/range addresses and lets unequal views share one object.
PROOF: identity survives projection
upstream evidence/receipts survive import
projection renderer cannot mutate canonical graph state
instruments.PROMISE: A view may hide or rearrange; it may not silently own or rewrite the source object.
instruments.PRICE: Address/provenance machinery is cognitively heavier than a one-off visualization.
instruments.RETURN: canonical identity + projection address + receipt lineage + upstream return address

instruments.PASSION: Let language be traversed, recomposed, heard, and remembered without erasing the source beneath the path.
instruments.PURPOSE: Address source cells, compose typed traversals, and replay those readings exactly.
instruments.POWER: CELL identity + BY edge + PATH program + ADDRESS compression can support several views without claiming geometry is semantics.
PROOF: path receipts round-trip
source tokens survive projections
typed non-geometric jumps remain explicit
instruments.PROMISE: Reachable or attractive geometry never automatically becomes authored meaning, prosody, or truth.
instruments.PRICE: Corpus adapters and typed edges add ceremony to what could otherwise be a quick visual toy.

instruments.PASSION: Make a source become a place you can traverse, test, remember, and return from without confusing representation with truth.
instruments.PURPOSE: Compile phrase + verse cell + figure into one deterministic city; require eight enacted evidence protocols; return to the origin with a portable, inspectable witness.
instruments.POWER: Couples reproducible text-built topology, provenance-bearing verse structure, figure-specific physics, distinct operator proofs, player trace, and bidirectional Return Artifact v2 in one run.
PROOF: identical phrase/cell/figure reconstruct the same world key and initial city
changing phrase, verse cell, or figure changes a mechanically visible world input
all eight Gate protocols require their enacted proof rather than proximity alone
Return Artifact v2 preserves source/provenance/figure/proof order/operator counts/path signature/steps/time and can restore only a verified matching world
recovered subset tests pass and prior build/render/360-city evidence remains provenance-linked
instruments.PROMISE: Movement, geometry, landmarks, ghosts, transport, or projection may change traversal and legibility; none may silently count as external truth or satisfy a Gate proof. Source, provenance, world identity, enacted evidence, and RETURN remain separable.
instruments.PRICE: Traversal and world simulation add friction and maintenance; every added city mechanic must earn itself through a distinct decision, consequence, replay value, transferable lesson, and inspectable return.
instruments.RETURN: Return Artifact v2: verified world identity + source/provenance + figure + eight Gate proofs + operator/path/measures + reproducible world address
instruments.canonical_identity: SLEEPER // ONE RETURN v2 / City Engine v0.2

instruments.PASSION: Feel a relation changing, rather than manipulate isolated parameters and read a dashboard afterward.
instruments.PURPOSE: Couple two cyclic states and expose the relation among them as BLOOM / FOLD / SPLIT / RETURN.
instruments.POWER: Makes the delta/relation itself first-class and embodied.
PROOF: relation mapping is deterministic
exported state reproduces the same relation
users can distinguish the relation without decorative explanation
instruments.PROMISE: The relation is a formal mapping in the instrument, not a claim that those verbs are universal meanings.
instruments.PRICE: Learned cyclic mapping and audiovisual richness can exceed the explanatory value.

instruments.PASSION: Let many unequal vocabularies become one graspable focus while the interface itself shows which next alignments remain possible.
instruments.PURPOSE: Align independent cyclic indices to one focus spine, reveal exact source identities, and expose the lawful neighborhood around the current tuple without hiding contradictions.
instruments.POWER: Every ring is selector, position indicator and constraint readout; a persistent mini overview preserves whole-stack orientation during deep focus, while an opt-in local witness exposes raw state and causal residue without taxing or silently adapting the primary interface.
PROOF: ordinary FIELD/HOUSE use produces recoverable focus addresses
lawful/dead support counts agree with exact source filtering
identity→rings→identity round-trip
URL reload reconstructs focus
plain chronology/faceted comparison after use
physical embodiment only if a useful ring composition earns it
reacquisition of current ring/value after interruption
wrong-ring-first and reverse-correction counts
overview use during re-entry / interruption
engineering witness can reconstruct the interaction path that produced a focus
instruments.PROMISE: Radial/cylindrical form earns complexity only if it makes possible moves and current correspondence easier to perceive than ordinary filters; zero-support states remain inspectable rather than silently corrected.
instruments.PRICE: Dense rings can overload labels; arbitrary cross-ring combinations can produce empty apertures; source schemas may need better dimensions.
instruments.RETURN: source + selected indices + per-position support + focus identity + projection + reloadable URL + explicit focus receipt

instruments.PASSION: Let a source become a path, a soundable shape, and a fabricable construction while keeping the route back to the source.
instruments.PURPOSE: Weave source cells into traversals, inspect/sonify their shape, and forge selected paths through symmetry/fabrication projections.
instruments.POWER: Moves one path across reading, HEAR SHAPE, symmetry, and fabrication preview without requiring those projections to become source truth.
PROOF: export/import preserves session/path
fabrication projection retains source/path identity
shape/audio projection can be removed without corrupting source
instruments.PROMISE: Construction and symmetry are derived projections; they do not confer authorship or semantic truth.
instruments.PRICE: A rich donor surface with many capabilities; only missing mechanisms should migrate into current heads.

instruments.PASSION: Keep one source graspable while attention changes scale, position, speed and voice, without manufacturing a second copy of the thing.
instruments.PURPOSE: Read one local text/JSON/object source through a stable addressed source position while scale, RSVP/voice time, ORP focus, linear source context and references change around it. Ring geometry is optional.
instruments.POWER: One compact kernel keeps source identity and canonical position stable while READFIELD presents the simplest useful projection first: ORP focus + linear source strip + direct pace + context. Hosts may opt into ring/material projections without forcing them on ordinary reading.
PROOF: field-aperture-focus/v0.2 preserves canonical char/path position across scale
READFIELD reader mode hides ring geometry while keeping source strip/focus/time operable
high-speed temporal focus updates faster than throttled prose-context reconstruction
route-wide READ handoff preserves caller RETURN
address resume, multilingual segmentation, finite RSVP, XREF and RAW remain browser-guarded
human comprehension advantage at high speed remains unclaimed
instruments.PROMISE: APERTURE is an inspection/projection utility, not an ontology or authority layer. Host material/ring/scale outputs are presentation-only. Bytes/magnitude, ring gap, scale, material variables, WPM and speech timing never imply semantic importance, truth, confidence or permission. It does not absorb AXIAL exact-set support, LensState typed transition law, or STATE APERTURE TEST/ARM/RUN consequence semantics.
instruments.PRICE: ORP and high-speed RSVP can exceed the value of plain reading; optional geometry can distract; speech-boundary fidelity varies by browser/voice. Keep the plain source and RETURN close.
instruments.RETURN: field-aperture-focus/v0.2 + addressed reader URL + exact caller RETURN; session-local handoff bytes remain host-owned.

boundary.constraint_surface: Computes exact possibility across a record set; APERTURE does not.
boundary.axial_focus_stack: Orients across unequal categorical dimensions; APERTURE inspects one source.
boundary.scale_lens: Owns deeper canonical identity/provenance across projections; APERTURE preserves only the local inspected source/address supplied to it.
boundary.lens_state: Checks typed projection/transition admissibility; APERTURE does not authorize composition.
boundary.state_aperture: Owns consequential transform/TEST/ARM/RUN lineage; APERTURE is presentation-only.
boundary.two_dial: Donates coupled cyclic-control feel; APERTURE does not universalize BLOOM/FOLD relation semantics.
boundary.rsvp: Donates temporal/speech focus; speed is a traversal parameter, not a comprehension claim.
